additional_info.subject: ID0450628-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / RD 170003083] Issue with FC14 and FC17. CRM:02699000246
additional_info.body:
Hello Szymon, good afternoon.
Did you had the time to check anything here?
I would start from FC14 where the light isn't even on, so from here we need to understand if the 24V supply is reaching FC14 > if the bridges connecting them is good or needs replacement.
For FC17 since it's red that means it tripped and we need to follow that line and find where the faulty component.
Please check if removing the 24V supply to the LED controller, the FC17 is working, if you plug in the 24V and the FC turns red, then we need to replace the KF15.
I recommend you to take 2 spare FC14/17 (they are the same) and KF15. Also the bridges.
Please let me know if you have any doubts or questions. I will send this ticket back to your queue RC-PL but feel free to reach out to me when you need.
Thanks a lot and have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
francisco

additional_info.subject: Summary of activities
additional_info.body:
On-site work was required.
During the station visit, the FC14 and FC17 fuses were checked.
Diagnosis:
- FC17 was functional; it only needed to be restarted and the cables tightened.
- FC14 - the problem was with the fuse and the KF1 controller power connector. The KF1 connector was completely loose and needed to be repaired.
After completing these steps, a restart was performed via a cold start, from the HMI panel, and from the SCB. All restarts were successful.
After a few days, the station became inactive in the SCB, but this was an issue with the XF3 router - the station is working properly in the backend system.
